headline: Fast Company says AI companies are now ready to pay publishers for their content, but the publishers get no say over the price.
score_reason: Lowered from 5 to 4: only the headline could be read, so the deals, prices and who sets them are unverified.
importance_line: Publishers and journalists are affected first, then AI companies that need news content; who sets prices, how much is paid and which firms are buying is not stated.
summary: Fast Company reports that publishers now have AI companies willing to buy their content but no say over the price.
notes: Headline only. Fast Company page returned HTTP 403 (also with other request styles) and no other outlet carried this exact story. Related but different stories (MediaPost on AI licensing, Digiday on SPUR) were not used for this entry.
